acceptanceCriteria: A full tick with an unchanged config identity does not read the config bytes.
A test pins the reuse and the existing replacement/restoration test still passes.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session.

Observed 2026-10-07 in the batch 4 integration (internal/tasks/dispatch/reload.go). Each full tick opens and reads the dispatch config to pair its bytes with their stat (30cb2c33), even when the cached identity (device, inode, size, mtime) already matches. Minor CPU and I/O on every full tick. Expected: an unchanged identity reuses the cached digest, while the stat/read pairing fix stays intact. Related: V1-0913.
title: dispatch: full ticks re-read the dispatch config even when its identity is unchanged
